DTU Chemistry
The Department of Chemistry (DTU Chemistry) conducts research, education and innovation in areas such as energy, life science, catalysis and materials. DTU Chemistry aims to contribute knowledge to basic scientific problems and to conduct research oriented towards application in society and businesses.

Organization
06 October 2026
New Head of Department at DTU Chemistry
Professor Søren Kegnæs will focus on areas including digitalization, innovation and well-being in his new role.
New Grant from the Independent Research Fund Denmark
11 May 2026
Major Grant of 6,3 mio. kr. from Independent Research Fund Denmark strengthens research at DTU Chemistry in CO₂ Capture and the Green Transition
Associate Professor Martin Nielsen, DTU Chemistry, has received a grant from Independent Research Fund Denmark / Natural Sciences to launch a new research project on integrated CO₂ capture and catalytic conversion.
New grant from Independent Research Fund Denmark
07 May 2026
New grant of 6.3 mio DKK from Independent Research Fund Denmark to transform CO₂ from a climate challenge into a chemical resource
A new research project at DTU Chemistry will develop green electrochemical processes capable of converting CO₂ into valuable chemicals for applications including the pharmaceutical and plastics industries.
Chemistry
23 April 2026
Scientists create a magnet with almost no magnetic field
A new paper in Nature Chemistry describes a molecular material that combines a stable internal magnetic structure with almost no external magnetic field. This could prove relevant for energy efficient electronics and spintronics.
